items.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
items.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Company’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

items.title: An inflation report Wednesday should be a big deal for the Fed. Here's what to expect
items.summary: The consumer price index is expected to show only a modest increase for July.

items.title: Private companies added just 44,000 workers in July, below expectations, ADP reports
items.summary: Hiring at private companies slowed considerably in July, with most of the job growth coming health care.

items.title: Is betting on elections using prediction markets illegal? Many states are unsure as midterms approach
items.summary: Twenty-three states have laws banning betting on elections, according to Pew Research. Not every state is sure these rules apply to prediction market trades.

items.title: AI computing power is becoming a tradable asset class as CME launches futures contracts
items.summary: The exchange is partnering with Silicon Data to introduce two compute futures contracts on Oct. 5, pending regulatory review.

items.title: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
